separated_control.purpose: Engineered easy-selection control: if selection fails here, the cause is tournament noise, not reference ambiguity at the cutoff.
separated_control.reference_gap: mu_field rank-6/7 gap 23.8 BB; P(same top 6) 0.999; P(6/7 reversal) 0.000; no reference-ambiguous bots.
separated_control.validation: Built once from the 2,000 existing pool rounds (construction gap 23.3 BB) and bound before validation; one-shot validation on 4,000 fresh pool-style rounds (seed family `fhr3b-2026-separated-control-validation`): P(leaders are the top 6) 0.998 (required >= 0.95), max non-leader P(top 6) 0.0015, gap 12.36 BB (one-sided 95% LCB 4.38). Field-relative mu_field reference generated independently afterwards.
separated_control.baseline: rerun changed qualifiers 3.83 [3.59, 4.07]; wrong vs mu_field 2.74 [2.50, 3.00]; regret 122.9 [110.3, 137.9] BB; rerun Spearman 0.43 [0.40, 0.46]; mu_swiss 200: changed 3.82 [3.69, 3.94], wrong 2.79 [2.66, 2.92].
separated_control.p_qualify: Leaders (mu_swiss 200): station-e2-s2 0.65, maniac-e2-s2 0.76, nit-e3-s1 0.58, station-e2-s3 0.31, trapper-e3-s3 0.52, neutral-e1-s0 0.39. Best non-leaders: maniac-e1-s0 (rank 17) 0.24, loose-e2-s1 (rank 9) 0.20 (P(qualify) is not monotone in mu_field below the gap). Exact reference top 6 selected in 2 of 250 tournaments.
separated_control.shows: Even with six independently validated leaders far above the rest, 40 x 400 adaptive Swiss misses about half of them per tournament; every wrong qualifier is clearly weaker.
separated_control.does_not_show: It is engineered (strongest defensible six plus the 54 weakest pool bots); it is not representative of any natural field. Its validation ran in pool context; the field-relative reference confirmed the separation.

crowded_cutoff.purpose: Qualification-boundary stress test: three designed leaders and a designed near-equal crowd at ranks 4 to about 15.
crowded_cutoff.reference_gap: mu_field rank-6/7 gap 0.61 BB at 500 matched rounds; P(same top 6) 0.205; P(6/7 reversal) 0.439; 7 reference-ambiguous bots.
crowded_cutoff.validation: Pre-registered mu_field rule fired at 250 and again at the 500-round ceiling (loose-e2-s1, outside the designed sets, P(top 6) 0.208). Carried as residual reference uncertainty. Designed leaders all have P(top 6) >= 0.95.
crowded_cutoff.baseline: rerun changed qualifiers 4.32 [4.12, 4.50]; wrong vs mu_field 3.52 [3.26, 3.80]; regret 93.7 [81.2, 105.3] BB; rerun Spearman 0.37 [0.34, 0.40]; mu_swiss 200: changed 4.19 [4.07, 4.31], wrong 3.46 [3.33, 3.59].
crowded_cutoff.p_qualify: Top mu_field ranks (mu_swiss 200): station-e2-s2 0.68, maniac-e2-s2 0.73, trapper-e3-s3 0.49, aggressive-e2-s0 0.26, aggressive-e1-s0 0.21, neutral-e1-s1 0.17, maniac-e2-s3 0.17, loose-e2-s1 0.18. Only 3 bots qualify with P >= 0.35 (station-e2-s2 (rank 1), maniac-e2-s2 (rank 2), trapper-e3-s3 (rank 3)); every other bot is at or below 0.26, on both sides of the reference boundary. Best bots outside the reference top 6: maniac-e1-s0 (rank 28) 0.21, station-e1-s0 (rank 13) 0.20, tight-e2-s3 (rank 9) 0.19.
crowded_cutoff.shows: Selection noise dominates even where the reference boundary is uncertain: 80% of wrong qualifiers are clearly outside the ambiguous set.
crowded_cutoff.does_not_show: Nothing about crowded fields as a class (one field). The reference top 6 below the three leaders is not settled.

style_diverse.purpose: Strategically heterogeneous field (style x strength balanced; no near-duplicate parameter vectors).
style_diverse.reference_gap: mu_field rank-6/7 gap 2.02 BB at 500 matched rounds; P(same top 6) 0.366; P(6/7 reversal) 0.353; 5 reference-ambiguous bots; rule does not fire at 500 (locked).
style_diverse.validation: Diversity audit: 8 archetypes, 60/60 distinct parameter vectors, 0 near-duplicate pairs (styles LA:17 LP:13 TA:13 TP:17).
style_diverse.baseline: rerun changed qualifiers 4.38 [4.18, 4.56]; wrong vs mu_field 3.80 [3.58, 4.08]; regret 94.3 [85.5, 103.7] BB; rerun Spearman 0.43 [0.41, 0.45]; mu_swiss 200: changed 4.43 [4.34, 4.52], wrong 3.79 [3.65, 3.92].
style_diverse.p_qualify: Top mu_field ranks (mu_swiss 200): maniac-e2-s2 0.69, station-e2-s2 0.48, trapper-e3-s3 0.22, nit-e3-s1 0.42, neutral-e2-s1 0.22, tight-e3-s2 0.17, loose-e0 0.21, neutral-e1-s2 0.14. Only 3 bots qualify with P >= 0.35 (maniac-e2-s2 (rank 1), station-e2-s2 (rank 2), nit-e3-s1 (rank 4)); every other bot is at or below 0.23, on both sides of the reference boundary. Best bots outside the reference top 6: tight-e2-s1 (rank 9) 0.23, aggressive-e3-s3 (rank 10) 0.22, station-e2-s1 (rank 12) 0.22.
style_diverse.shows: Results from the other two fields are not an artefact of near-duplicate agents: reliability is similar with strategically distinct bots.
style_diverse.does_not_show: Nothing about style mixes in general; one field, synthetic stateless agents.
